title: Vector Field Histogram
text: Avoid obstacles using vector field histogram, 3 inputs, 1 output; {Number of angular sectors} sets the number of bins used to create, {Range distance limits (m)} sets the limits for range readings, {Histogram thresholds} sets the thresholds for computing binary histogram, {vehicle radius (m)} sets the radius of the vehicle, {Safety distance (m)} sets the safety distance around the vehicle, {Minimum turning radius (m)} sets the minimum turning radius at current speed, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run, {Target direction weight} sets the cost function weight for target direction, {Current direction weight} sets the cost function weight for current direction and {Previous direction weight} sets the cost function weight for previous. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Ranges
ports.summary: Range values from scan data vector of scalars

ports.name: Angles
ports.summary: Angle values from scan data vector of scalars

params.name: Number of angular sectors
params.values: Number of bins used to create the histograms 180 (default) | scalar

params.name: Range distance limits (m)
params.values: Limits for range readings [0.05 2] (default) | two-element vector of scalars

params.name: Histogram thresholds
params.values: Thresholds for computing binary histogram [3 10] (default) | two-element vector of scalars

params.name: Safety distance (m)
params.values: Safety distance around the vehicle 0.1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Minimum turning radius (m)
params.values: Minimum turning radius at current speed 0.1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution

params.name: Target direction weight
params.values: Cost function weight for target direction 5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Current direction weight
params.values: Cost function weight for current direction 2 (default) | scalar

params.name: Previous direction weight
params.values: Cost function weight for previous direction 2 (default) | scalar
